Los recomiendo totalmente a cualquier persona que busque una empresa confiable, transparente y comprometida con obtener buenos resultados. ¡Muchas gracias por su excelente trabajo!

reviews.text:

I highly recommend Jessica and the team at Intercredit Solution to anyone looking for honest, reliable, and personalized assistance.

Thank you for the exceptional service!"

reviews.author: Go2 Tax Services
reviews.text:
Tuve una excelente experiencia con Intercredit Solution. Desde el primer contacto recibí una atención profesional, clara y personalizada. Siempre estuvieron disponibles para resolver mis dudas y explicarme todo el proceso.

En solo 3 meses lograron mejorar mi crédito exactamente como lo necesitaba, demostrando eficiencia, honestidad y compromiso. Los recomiendo 100%, es una empresa confiable y muy profesional.

reviews.author: michael rodriguez
reviews.text: When looking to fix credit, please look no further. Jessica and her team got to work right away and in a very timely manner. I had a few things to handle on my credit and Jessica got the job done! I feel like other companies would give me the run around and were not clear on what to expect. Intercredit Solutions gave me a plan and were very direct on what they were going to do. They do what they say they're going to doand do not shy away. They were very accessible at any moment I needed to speak with them. The one time fee was perfect for me and I felt comfortable. I do not like the idea of a monthly fee other companies offer and not knowing what outcome to expect or in how long. Jessica and her team are very nice too, its a plus! Thank you Intercredit Solutions, I highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Marcos Ramirez
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio, inigualable, ambiente amigable. Cuando llegué a la oficina de Jessica Sotolongo, me recibió con una sonrisa alegre e incluso me ofreció café.

Nos pusimos manos a la obra, pero me sentí cómodo y ella fue muy honesta y abierta sobre mi situación. No hizo nada a menos que yo lo aceptara. ¡Gracias a ella pude arreglar mi crédito para conseguir un auto!

Incluso me dijo que la llamara antes de recibir el auto para que me aconsejara sobre los pasos a seguir. ¡GRACIAS JESSICA SOTOLONGO y su equipo de Intercredit Solution por toda su ayuda con mi crédito!

reviews.author: Vivencias Global
reviews.text: Excellent service. Very professional team

reviews.author: Vivianne Zerquera
reviews.text: Working with Jessica at Intercredit Solutions has been an absolute pleasure! From the very beginning, she has been one of the kindest, most understanding, and dedicated professionals I’ve ever had the chance to work with. When I first came to her, my credit score was in the low 500s and now, just a few months later, we’re approaching 700! Jessica has truly gone above and beyond to help me every step of the way. I’m so grateful for all of her hard work and support, and I highly recommend her services to anyone looking to improve their credit. You’ll be in great hands!

reviews.author: Shenise Wray
reviews.text:
Jessica was extremely helpful in guiding me through the entire process regarding my credit score, outstanding debts, and the available options to resolve them. She explained everything clearly and with genuine care, which gave me a much better understanding of where I stand and how to move forward.

By the end of our consultation, I felt hopeful and excited about the journey toward becoming debt-free and rebuilding my credit. I truly appreciate her professionalism and support.

Highly recommend Inter-Credit Solutions, especially if you’re looking for someone who makes the process less overwhelming and more empowering!

reviews.author: M. Gabriela Mantilla
reviews.text:
Agradezco la asesoría brindada por la señora Sotolongo, comprendí que estaba trabajando en mejorar mi crédito, pero no utilizaba los recursos necesarios y eso hacia el progreso más lento además de los errores que se cometen por falta de conocimientos en el tema.

Recomiendo que si tienes dudas sobre tu crédito te asesores con ella, te explica de una forma fácil y clara.

Gracias,
